correctness.rationale: For two-state symmetric exchange with mass one and two strictly positive starts, insert the published coefficients alpha_1=0,alpha_2=1,beta_1=2,beta_2=0 and MPE one-step weight denominators. Solving the two-by-two transfer system yields the displayed rational imbalance recurrence, with strictly positive components for all finite h>0. Jacobian at equilibrium has a=1/(1+4h), b=-8h²/[(1+2h)(1+4h)] and dominant negative spectral root modulus rho. p(-1),p(0),p(1) show local attraction; comparing p at MPE m proves rho>m. Implicit differentiation yields stationarity quartic 32h⁴+32h³−8h²−8h−1=0; exactly one positive root by Descartes, derivative sign changes from negative to positive. Independent symbolic reconstruction, 125 exact rational two-state updates and both asymptotic series match h*=.5365660925 and rho*=.767326988. Only a local equilibrium spectral claim, not global convergence.
